body:
What moves: pet walks to its bed or dog house, turns once, curls up, slow breathing, z z Z.
When: tired (rest need) and when you sleep. Wakes up when you wake.
No bed: curls up on the floor near you.
Models: pet beds (small, medium, large) and dog house in Model Compare.
Stage: beds are pet-yard items, so this waits for the backyard (stage 3).
Friends see this move too (Plan, 31 Oct: pets are sent online for real).

comments.text: Redone (your ask: bending legs, better physics): legs now bend at hip and knee with real gaits, head and tail move, people swing their arms, jumps follow an arc with crouch and landing squash, blob shadows. 6 critic rounds: best 6.5 of 10, never 8, so not passed yet.

short: Pets sleep in beds and dog houses
source: chat 30 Oct: Model movements, first drafts
title: Pets sleep in beds and dog houses
